Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscounted oxygen atoms when evaluating option B, incorrectly treating each H2O as containing two oxygen atoms. They concluded the products had 10 O atoms (4 from CO2 + 6 from H2O) instead of the correct 7 (4 + 3), leading to the wrong selection of B. The correctly balanced combustion of ethane is option D (2C2H6 + 7O2 -> 4CO2 + 6H2O).
